component.name: Botlyx Tutor
component.summary: Local-first AI study app for your documents

description.p: Botlyx Tutor turns any document into an interactive study space — on your own computer, with your own AI keys.
Import PDF, Word, PowerPoint, EPUB, text or Markdown into a clean reader. Select any passage and instantly:

ul.li: Translate it into the language you choose
Summarize the document into structured notes
Generate a quiz for active recall

description.p: Private by design: your documents and library stay on your machine. No subscription: bring your own key (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek or OpenRouter), or run a fully local model with Ollama, offline. Math (LaTeX) and code blocks render correctly, and the interface is available in 12 languages. A license unlocks the document features.

screenshot.caption: Read documents and act on any passage with AI
Explain any selection in clear language
Translate passages into the language you choose

description.p: Initial release: AI-powered reader for PDF, Word, PowerPoint, EPUB, text and Markdown. Explain, translate, summarize, quiz and chat with any passage. BYOK or local Ollama. UI in 12 languages.
